name: proof-negative-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.proof-worker.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; bun test core/proof-output.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts research/bapa/proof-capture.test.ts research/bapa/proof-codec.test.ts research/bapa/proof-projection.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; set +e; bun research/bapa/proof-worker.ts --only consensus --broken > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/broken.log" 2>&1; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; bun -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"), p=process.env.SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR+"/consensus-broken/", r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p+"result.json")), v=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p+"verdict.json")); if(r.variant!=="broken"||r.publicCalls!==1||r.proven||r.checked||r.status!=="not-verified"||r.outputError||v.stuck!=="sat"||(!v.witness&&!v.run))process.exit(32); console.log(JSON.stringify({variant:r.variant,calls:r.publicCalls,proven:r.proven,checked:r.checked,stuck:v.stuck,run:!!v.run,witness:!!v.witness}))' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/control.json"; printf '%s\n' 'feat(research): add same-profile broken BAPA worker mode' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1
